name: frontier
notes: No crutches beyond a nudge and one retry. If this profile ever needs more, the loop has a bug — do not paper over it here. thinking=adaptive is what these models already do when asked for nothing, so declaring it changes no spend on the direct Anthropic path; it is here so the declaration matches the request, and so 'off' stays sayable. sampling=model-default because temperature is a 400 on all three Claude globs (Opus 4.7 and later removed it) — which also un-breaks retryOnce: at the model's own temperature a resend is no longer byte-identical, so the step finally does something.
